traceability.notes: docs/stories/008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX.story.md is a concrete implementation story, not just a planning document. The plugin implements ESLint auto-fix for missing @story annotations (require-story-annotation) and safe suffix-only @story path normalization (valid-annotation-format), with behavior gated by configurable templates and autoFix flags as described in the story. Tests in tests/rules/auto-fix-behavior-008.test.ts explicitly cover REQ-AUTOFIX-MISSING, REQ-AUTOFIX-FORMAT, REQ-AUTOFIX-TEMPLATE, and REQ-AUTOFIX-SELECTIVE, and all pass in the current Jest run. The rules’ source files carry traceability annotations to Story 008.0 and the relevant REQ-AUTOFIX-* requirements, and user-docs/api-reference.md documents the auto-fix behaviors, options, and safety constraints. All acceptance criteria in the story (core functionality, quality/safety, integration, user experience, error handling via conservative non-fixing of ambiguous cases, and documentation) are satisfied, so the story is fully implemented.
